description: Shared test vector for the capstone freeze. Inputs are inline JSON strings (decode them, then encode as UTF-8 to get the bytes; CR and LF are the escapes \r and \n). data_agent maps each relative POSIX path to its file content. Recompute every component, the overall hash and the short hash by the algorithm in the docstring of src/lakehouse/capstone/freeze.py.

data_agent.instructions/system.md:
Answer in at most 25 rows.
Use the gold schema only.
data_agent.unicode/\uff5e.md: fullwidth tilde, a BMP character above the surrogates
